issuer: the Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA)
note: GOV.UK (read 2026-10-30) gives a first provisional licence at £34 online (£43 by post), from 15 years and 9 months, and the first full licence after passing the driving test free; the fee held is the £34 a full licence costs to get. A photocard licence is renewed every 10 years (£14 online). Most people can start learning to drive at 17, so a full licence is kept from 17. The DVLA issues no identity card; a provisional licence serves as photo ID but isn't held as a card. The table covers Great Britain; Northern Ireland's licences are the DVA's and aren't held apart.
